about.title: About Silent Time
about.intro: I am Xiao Dong, a full-stack developer. This is where I record real trade-offs, pitfalls, and solutions from actual projects — distilling experience into reusable methods.
about.engineeringTitle: Engineering thinking to make complex problems clear
about.deliveryTitle: From interface to server, the full delivery chain
about.stackDesc: Tools change; the ability to solve problems does not. Technical choices prioritize maintainability, verifiability, and team fit.
about.contactTitle: Have a question worth discussing? Write to me.
about.principle1Desc: Start from user goals and system boundaries — avoid masking unclear problems with more code.
about.principle2Desc: Break down complexity; use clear data flow, automated tests, and documentation to guard long-term maintainability.
about.principle3Desc: Make every iteration visible, verifiable, and leave room for the next improvement.
tools.intro: 御器 means "tool". This is where I collect the tools I use and build — the term extractor is the first; document converters and media converters will follow. The term extractor is linked with the blog: every article is automatically distilled into a term.
tools.random-lex.name: Term Extractor
tools.random-lex.desc: Draw terms at random for focused study, with a three-phase timer and text-to-speech. The word bank syncs with blog articles automatically; blog terms link back to the original.

fileMgr.tutorial.title: File center tutorial
fileMgr.tutorial.intro: File links come from the blog. No storage configuration is needed, and never paste server-internal addresses into articles.
fileMgr.tutorial.uploadDesc: Drag files in or click "Upload file". Single files up to 1 GB; images, PDF, Word, Excel, audio and video are detected automatically.
fileMgr.tutorial.linkDesc: After upload, choose "Copy link". Public file links can be used directly in blog bodies, covers, or download buttons.
fileMgr.tutorial.insertDesc: Paste the link in the content editor. Use the image component for images and plain links for PDFs or documents; preview before publishing.
fileMgr.tutorial.downloadDesc: Downloads keep the original file name. Confirm articles no longer reference a link before deleting; if storage is briefly unavailable, records are kept for retry.
fileMgr.tutorial.faqDesc: For upload failures, check format and size first. If you see "storage has reached the safe threshold", delete unneeded files; uploading resumes automatically after space is freed. If preview fails but the file downloads, the browser likely does not support the format.
fileMgr.tutorial.legacyDesc: Old /media/ files and new AstraStoreXion files are shown together; no manual migration needed.
